causal_hypothesis: Attempt10 touched the rim without stable grasp or lift. Pregrasp alone leaves engagement to the failing base VLA. Execute reviewed engagement, closure and target-specific lift; interrupt closed separated targets or stalled contact before complete occlusion.

critic_rules.proposal: Interrupt the initial hold to enter the frozen pregrasp commissioning recovery.
critic_rules.title: Supervised pregrasp commissioning request

critic_rules.proposal: Interrupt closed unretained target before tracking is lost; execute audited target recovery.
critic_rules.title: Closed gripper remains separated from pink target

critic_rules.proposal: Interrupt stalled contact without a verified grasp; review current target and grip before retry.
critic_rules.title: Contact without target lift

mechanism_change: Add explicit engage/close/contact-gated lift and two measured retention critics. Retry opening is admitted only at the configured empty stop with separated unlifted target.

recovery_rules.fallback: Record failure and end the attempt. Use existing verified homing/unload cleanup; do not bypass review or silently switch engines.
recovery_rules.precondition: Fresh observed target; open grip or calibrated empty-stop with target separated and unlifted. Possible held objects deny opening.
safety_constraints: Only the gateway executes motor targets.
Fresh single-use tokens, joint limits and step budgets are enforced.
No automatic opening if current suggests an object may be held.
TCP clearance is not a full arm/finger collision certificate.
Supervised commissioning; delivered unvalidated configuration has motion disabled.
Closed no-lift contact can be a rim collision: opening is denied unless empty-stop plus separated unlifted target is freshly observed.

steps.stop_when: Observed open gripper; refuse unknown or possible held object.
Fresh pink target cloud and metric proposal are recorded.
Fresh same-target joint IK and TCP clearance are eligible.
Measured TCP reaches pregrasp; sent commands and feedback are recorded separately.
Fresh pink target cloud and metric proposal are recorded.
Fresh same-target joint IK and TCP clearance are eligible.
Measured TCP reaches pregrasp; sent commands and feedback are recorded separately.
Measured pregrasp completed and fresh same-target scene admits engagement.
Measured TCP reaches the target proxy, not just pregrasp.
Measured settled closure; preserve existing +0.9 command preload.
Observed same-target contact and completed engage permit small lift.
Measured TCP lift; only observed target lift can count success.
Five fresh observations verify target co-motion and pink lift success.
Same-target measured pregrasp, healthy sensors and critic clearance permit reentry.
One bounded fresh VLA chunk or runtime terminal verdict.

recovery_rules.stop_condition: Pink-target 1cm lift held for five fresh frames ends success; honor runtime budgets.
recovery_rules.title: Measured pink target engagement and retained lift

validation_plan: Replay attempt10 critics before new physical trial; bounded full runner, same Model A seed42, five fresh frames of verified pink 1cm lift. No promotion from one rollout.
